title: ArchitectureRequirementCompliance
description: TOGAF-sourced norm archetype — the measurable compliance facet of a TOGAF Requirement. While the Requirement directive (directives/Requirement) captures governance intent (WHAT must be achieved), this schema captures the measurable assertion (HOW to verify compliance). Requires GSM unsealing of Norm to be functional. Extends Norm with TOGAF compliance measurement vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Requirement compliance assessment (ADM Requirements Management). Source framework: TOGAF (ADM, Requirements Management).

requirementType.description: Requirement classification (mirrors the Requirement directive). TOGAF mapping: Requirement type (ADM Requirements Management).

complianceLevel.description: Target compliance level. FULL = must satisfy completely. PARTIAL = acceptable partial satisfaction. WAIVED = exempted with governance approval. TOGAF mapping: Requirement compliance assessment.

measurementMethod.description: Method for measuring compliance (e.g., 'automated-test', 'manual-review', 'monitoring'). TOGAF mapping: Requirement verification method.
